name: _view.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  space-playground/_view.scss — the space-playground view itself — :host fullscreen canvas mount, the .sp-canvas element, and the no-WebGL fallback surface.
//  Imported by space-playground.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

:host {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: transparent;
}

// The Three.js Earth canvas (fixed fullscreen behind the panel).
.#{$_B_SP}-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  z-index: 0;

  // Dead GL context after a failed boot — hidden so the CSS starfield
  // shows through instead of an opaque black framebuffer.
  &.is-fallback {
    visibility: hidden;
  }
}

// Static deep-space fallback — mounted when the engine can't boot
// (WebGL disallowed/unavailable, init failure). Keeps the route legible
// instead of leaving a black void.
.#{$_B_SP}-fallback {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 55% at 50% 62%, rgba($color-blue, 0.28) 0%, transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at center,
      rgba($color-blue, 0.3) 0%,
      rgba($color-black, 0.9) 60%,
      var(--bg-dark) 100%
    );
}
